pkgmetadata.longdescription: DLSS Updater scans games installed through Steam, Wine and other launchers for DLSS, XeSS and FSR DLLs, backs up originals and can replace them with newer releases. This package extracts the upstream amd64 Flatpak's PyInstaller application and pairs it with the matching Flet 1.0.0 Linux client. It uses host GTK and libsecret libraries; it does not install a Flatpak runtime. Game DLLs are downloaded to the user's cache at runtime.
